Force every user-facing string from an AI agent into plain language a non-technical human can read.

items.description: Keep the user's personal life diary for them. Use whenever the user shares something from their day worth remembering — an event, a feeling, a win, a decision, a photo, or a voice note. The user should never have to open an app or write an entry themselves; you capture life as it happens and file it by date. Triggers on "remember this", "add to my diary", "save this photo for today", "journal that", "what did I do last week", "on this day", or any moment the user is clearly recording their life.
